node.title: Re: Growing strings in search
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: Is there any chance you can provide an [id://1177642|SSCCE]? In theory, it's possible to both check and change the regex engine's position via [doc://pos], but as [choroba] [id://11115573|said], in lots of cases you'd actually have to backtrack an unknown amount, and that may not be feasible with [doc://pos] - depending on the specific case.
